_about: Ways to earn besides government jobs, shown in the app (#earn) and as static pages (jobs/earn/). Every fact is quoted from the company's or ministry's own Google Play listing or website on the date in 'checked'; 'downloads' is the Play count that day. Re-check before changing a fact. Do not list apps that ask for money to earn, APKs, phone numbers or WhatsApp groups.

groups.title: Delivery Boy Jobs {y}: Blinkit, Zomato, Swiggy, Zepto, Flipkart — How to Join (Official Apps)
groups.hindi: डिलीवरी बॉय जॉब {y}: ब्लिंकिट, ज़ोमैटो, स्विगी, ज़ेप्टो — कैसे जॉइन करें
groups.intro: Food, grocery and parcel delivery is the most common way to start earning quickly in Indian cities. You join through each company's own partner app: it asks for your documents, checks them and shows the work near you. Earnings are paid per order or per delivery; the amounts below are what each company states on its official app page, not a fixed salary.

options.name: Blinkit
says: Earn up to ₹30,000 per month
Orders from a nearby store, within 3 km
Daily or weekly payouts
Joining bonus up to ₹6,000*
₹10 lakh life insurance and ₹1 lakh health insurance
EV bike on rent

options.name: Zomato
says: Earn up to ₹30,000 per month, paid per delivery
Join with Aadhaar and PAN, then online training
Works in 500+ cities

options.name: Swiggy
says: Earn up to ₹60,000 per month
Joining bonus up to ₹10,000
Works in 600+ cities

options.name: Zepto
says: Paid per order, with a minimum business guarantee
Deliveries within 3 km of the store

options.name: Shadowfax
says: Earn up to ₹45,000+ per month, weekly payouts
Anyone 18+ with valid Aadhaar, PAN and a bank account
Bike, scooter, bicycle or EV (rent available) and an Android phone
Insurance up to ₹7.5 lakh
2,500+ cities

options.name: Flipkart (Ekart)
says: Earn up to ₹40,000 per month, paid weekly or fortnightly
No investment required: Aadhaar, PAN card and a bike
Parcel, grocery and 10-minute delivery roles

options.name: Delhivery
says: Earn up to ₹40,000 per month, weekly payouts
Needs Aadhaar, PAN, a bank account, an Android phone; age 18+
EV on rent at ₹150 a day
Eligible partners may move to on-roll employment
steps: Install the app and create your profile
An executive calls you to complete joining

groups.title: Driver Jobs {y}: Rapido, Uber, Ola, Namma Yatri, Porter — Bike, Auto, Cab and Tempo (Official Apps)
groups.hindi: ड्राइवर जॉब {y}: रैपिडो, उबर, ओला, पोर्टर — बाइक, ऑटो, कैब
groups.intro: If you have a driving licence and a vehicle (bike, auto, cab or goods vehicle), you can earn by giving rides or moving goods through these apps. Each company checks your licence and vehicle papers in its own driver app. What you earn depends on the rides you take; the facts below are from each company's official app page.

options.name: Rapido
says: Bike taxi, auto and cab rides
₹5 lakh* insurance on every ride

options.name: Namma Yatri
says: Zero commission: you keep 100% of the fare
Needs driving licence and vehicle registration (RC)
Bengaluru, Delhi, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kochi, Mysuru and Tumakuru

options.name: Porter
says: Bike, three-wheeler, tempo, Tata Ace, mini-truck and pickup
Instant or daily payouts
No forced login or shift commitments
34+ cities

groups.title: Part Time Jobs {y}: Genuine Job Apps With No Fees, and How to Spot Fake Work-From-Home Offers
groups.hindi: पार्ट टाइम जॉब {y}: बिना फ़ीस वाले असली जॉब ऐप, और फ़र्ज़ी 'घर बैठे जॉब' से कैसे बचें
groups.intro: For part-time, full-time, fresher and internship jobs in private companies, use the big job apps: you make a profile and apply or talk to the employer directly. They are free for job seekers. Fake 'work from home' and 'task' jobs that ask you to pay first are a common fraud in India; see the warning signs below.

options.name: WorkIndia
says: 100% free job app: no consultancy or hidden charges
Call the HR directly

options.name: Indeed
says: Free job search app

options.name: Internshala
says: Free to register

options.name: Urban Company
says: For beauty, cleaning, repair and other home-service professionals
You pay only when you send quotes to customers

groups.title: Government Schemes to Earn {y}: PM Internship, e-Shram, Skill India, Apprenticeship, Mudra Loan, PM SVANidhi
groups.hindi: कमाई के लिए सरकारी योजनाएँ {y}: पीएम इंटर्नशिप, ई-श्रम, स्किल इंडिया, अप्रेंटिसशिप, मुद्रा लोन, पीएम स्वनिधि
groups.intro: Free government help for people who want work or want to start their own: internships with a stipend, skill courses, apprenticeships, a card for unorganised and gig workers, and small loans without collateral. Apply only on the official sites below; nobody needs to be paid to get you in.

options.name: PM Internship Scheme
options.developer: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
says: For youth aged 18–25 who are not in full-time employment
Family income below ₹12 lakh a year
Apply for up to three internships with no fees

options.name: PM Mudra Yojana
says: Loans without collateral to start or grow a small business
Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishore ₹50,000–₹5 lakh; Tarun ₹5–10 lakh; Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh for those who repaid a Tarun loan
Apply online on Udyam Mitra or at a bank

options.name: PM SVANidhi
says: Loans for street vendors: ₹15,000, then ₹25,000, then ₹50,000
Needs a Certificate of Vending or a Letter of Recommendation from the Urban Local Body

warning.title: How to spot a fake job or earning offer
signs: They ask you to pay a registration, joining, kit or 'security' fee to an agent or a person before you get work
They pay a little for small 'tasks' (likes, reviews, typing) and then ask you to invest more
Contact only through WhatsApp or Telegram, never through an official app or website
Promises like ₹5,000–₹10,000 a day from home with no skills
An APK file to install from a link instead of Google Play
warning.report: If you were cheated, report it on cybercrime.gov.in or call the cybercrime helpline 1930.
